# Work with a repository

> Two letters, and a full TUI when two letters are not enough.

Almost everything is `g`, which is git. When a diff needs looking at rather than reading, `lg` opens lazygit on the current repository.

## `g`

**Run git**

*shell*

`g` is `git`: `g status`, `g push`, everything as usual, three characters shorter.

See also: [`lg`](./git.md#lg)  
Spec: `prds/04-shell/02-aliases-utilities/prd.md`

## `lg`

**Open lazygit on this repository**

*shell*

`lg` in any repo: staging, hunk-level commits, rebases and the log in one terminal UI. Quit with `q`.

See also: [`g`](./git.md#g)  
Spec: `prds/04-shell/02-aliases-utilities/prd.md`
